name: Archestra
description: Run MCP servers for an enterprise behind one gateway — a curated registry, dynamic tool loading, prompt-injection guardrails, and per-agent access policy.

skills.name: Gateway Routing
skills.description: Fronts many MCP servers behind a single endpoint, routing tool calls and centralizing credentials and audit logging.

skills.name: Injection Guardrails
skills.description: Inspects tool results for prompt-injection patterns and blocks or quarantines responses before they reach the model.

skills.name: Dynamic Tool Loading
skills.description: Exposes only the tools relevant to the current task, keeping large catalogs from flooding the model context window.
